question: A committee was set up in __________ under the chairmanship of R.N. Malhotra, former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India, to make recommendations for reforms in the insurance sector.
solution: The correct answer is __**1993**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • A committee was set up in the year **1993** under the chairmanship of **R.N. Malhotra**, who was the former Governor of the Reserve Bank of India, to suggest reforms in the **insurance sector**. • The **Malhotra Committee** was tasked with evaluating the structure of the insurance industry in India and recommending reforms to make it more efficient and competitive. • The committee submitted its report in **1994**, and its recommendations paved the way for the **liberalization of the insurance sector** in India. • One of the key recommendations was the establishment of the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** to regulate and promote the insurance industry. • The committee also recommended the entry of private players and foreign companies into the insurance sector to enhance competition and improve service delivery.
